description: Portable update and migration vectors an installation must refuse safely. Each vector is a plan document shape derived from the pinned specification update-plan contract, carrying the four hazard classes plus a valid control and three boundary cases. fixtures/update/driver.py checks the corpus is self-consistent and crates/axiom-graphd/tests/update_fixtures.rs replays every vector through the real axiom_graphd::update_guard admission surface, the real commands::update delegation, the real graph_store::migrations schema ceiling and the real graph_store::backup verification.
invariant: CF-021: tampered, expired or incompatible update input is never installed. CF-026: a schema future major produces an explicit incompatible error instead of a downgrade.

scenarios.expected_outcome: The trust metadata expiry is before the plan creation time, so the plan is refused before any delegation and the target tree keeps its bytes.
The plan carries no signature, so the signer is absent and the plan is refused rather than treated as implicitly trusted.
The candidate schema major is newer than this binary supports, so the store is never migrated downwards and the existing database is untouched.
The plan requires a backup that is not present, so the irreversible step is refused and the missing file is never created.
A trusted, unexpired plan at a supported schema with a present backup is admitted and delegated as program plus argv.
Boundary: an expiry equal to the creation time is already not-after, so it is refused exactly like an expiry in the past.
Boundary: a candidate schema major equal to the supported major is compatible and admitted, so only a strictly newer major is refused.
Boundary: a plausible plan with no approval digest is still refused by the real delegation, so admission is never the default.
